svg.title: Foamrest Inn — Foamrest shell lodge
svg.desc: A shell-vaulted common room opens onto a sunset deck. Bunk lofts, luggage shelves and a serving hatch make an upper loop around the central hearth. Editable design layers: architecture, walkable ledges, supported climbs, jumpable props, numbered exits and NPCs.

g.text: Climbable stairs / ladders / ropes · pale edges are landable
Solid route stays open · furniture tops add optional hops

svg.text: A shell-vaulted common room opens onto a sunset deck. Bunk lofts, luggage shelves and a
